title: DevSpire Nexus AI Model Record
description: Schema contract for AI foundation models, fine-tunes, and model families.

publisher.description: Lab, organization, or author releasing the model weights or API.

family.description: Associated model series or architecture family (e.g. Llama, Mistral, GPT, Claude).

open_weights.description: Whether weights are downloadable and locally runnable.

license_group.description: Grouped license taxonomy (e.g. MIT / Apache 2.0, Permissive Community, Commercial).

context.description: Human-readable context window description (e.g. 128K tokens, 1M tokens).

context_k.description: Numeric context window length in thousands of tokens (e.g. 128 for 128K).

moe.description: Whether the architecture utilizes Mixture-of-Experts routing.

modalities.description: Supported input and output modalities (e.g. Text, Code, Vision, Audio, Video).
